    • getArguments

      public static Map<ArgumentData<?>, Object> getArguments(List<ArgumentData<?>> arguments, com.mojang.brigadier.context.CommandContext<io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.CommandSourceStack> context, ScriptCommandExecutionEvent commandEvent) throws com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException
      Utility method for mapping a list of ArgumentDatas to their real values given context.
      Parameters:
      arguments - Arguments to map to values.
      context - Command context for obtaining argument values.
      commandEvent - Event context for resolving default values.
      Returns:
      A map of arguments to their values. Arguments that fail to resolve to a value are not included.
      Throws:
      com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException - If an error occurs while resolving certain arguments.

    • getArgument

      @Nullable public static @Nullable Object getArgument(ArgumentData<?> argument, Set<String> providedArguments, com.mojang.brigadier.context.CommandContext<io.papermc.paper.command.brigadier.CommandSourceStack> context, ScriptCommandExecutionEvent commandEvent) throws com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException
      Utility method for mapping a ArgumentData to its real value given context.
      Parameters:
      argument - The argument to map to a value.
      providedArguments - A set of arguments known to be provided in the context.
      context - Command context for obtaining argument values.
      commandEvent - Event context for resolving default values.
      Returns:
      The real value of argument given context. Null if argument was not provided, and it does not have a default value.
      Throws:
      com.mojang.brigadier.exceptions.CommandSyntaxException - If an error occurs while resolving this argument.
